libraryPreparationPreflight.agent_guidance: Favor ApplicationContextRunner/annotation-metadata style assertions over tests that perform real repository CRUD against Couchbase — e.g. verify @DataCouchbaseTest's imported auto-configurations, DataCouchbaseTypeExcludeFilter inclusion/exclusion behavior on sample @Document/@Repository fixtures, and annotation attribute defaults, the same way the merged spring-boot-data-couchbase test (tests/src/org.springframework.boot/spring-boot-data-couchbase/4.1.1) validated bean wiring without a live connection. Add testImplementation on org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-couchbase, spring-boot-data-couchbase, spring-boot-autoconfigure and spring-boot-test as needed, following that sibling's build.gradle.
risks: If local Gradle/Native-Image verification shows the slice annotation eagerly requires a live connection (contradicting the Couchbase SDK's documented non-blocking connect behavior), a CouchbaseContainer Docker image would need to be added — none is currently allow-listed in tests/tck-build-logic/src/main/resources/allowed-docker-images/.
libraryPreparationPreflight.summary: Test-slice module (@DataCouchbaseTest) for the just-merged spring-boot-data-couchbase autoconfiguration; its beans are testable via ApplicationContextRunner/annotation metadata without a live Couchbase server, matching the sibling module's proven approach. No Couchbase Docker image is pinned in this repo and none is needed for meaningful coverage.
